name: Dak N'rung pepper
summary: Large, round, plump peppercorns from Đắk N'rung with a strong fragrance. White pepper comes packed to carry home as a gift.
origin: The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023. The handbook’s gift section ends by citing VnExpress.
texture: The handbook says the berries are large, round, plump, and fragrant.
howToEat: Buy the packed white pepper as a gift.
where: The tourism portal’s Tuy Đức note puts pepper with coffee at Quảng Tân and Đắk R'tíh.
seoTitle: Hat tieu Dak N'rung — pepper to carry home
seoDescription: Đắk N'rung pepper, large and fragrant, with white pepper packed as a gift.
